        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = scanner.next();
        int mark = 0;
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        int n = s.length();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (i == 0) {
                result.append(s.charAt(i));
            } else if (i + 2 < n && s.charAt(i) == 'd' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 'o' && s.charAt(i + 2) == 't' && i + 2 != n - 1) {
                result.append('.');
                i += 2;
            } else if (mark == 0 && i + 1 < n && s.charAt(i) == 'a' && s.charAt(i + 1) == 't' && i + 1 != n - 1) {
                result.append('@');
                mark++;
                i++;
            } else {
                result.append(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }
        System.out.println(result.toString());
        scanner.close();
    }
}
